ArchitectureNotes.objective: Port Mark Text off abandoned Electron 18 + Vue 2 stack onto (A) modern Electron 30 + Vue 3 as intermediate v1.0, then (B) Tauri v2 + Rust as final v2.0, while merging 13 community PRs and delivering a Homebrew-installable, ad-hoc-signed macOS app.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Do NOT rewrite muya. It has zero Electron coupling (verified by grep) and ports to WebView unchanged.
Do NOT engage with upstream marktext/marktext maintainers. This is an independent fork.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: PR #4001 (electron-vite refactor) conflicts with bugfix PRs — resolved by merge-order: bugfixes first, then #4001.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: muya in WKWebView may be slower than Chromium on large docs — benchmark gate at Phase-B1.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: All 6 native modules (keytar, chokidar, fontmanager-redux, native-keymap, vscode-ripgrep, @hfelix/electron-localshortcut) must be replaced in Phase B.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-4: electron-store → tauri-plugin-store schema migration is one-way and must preserve user prefs.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-5: NSSpellChecker has no existing Tauri plugin; custom objc2 FFI required for Phase-B3.
ArchitectureNotes.strategy: Hybrid two-phase: Phase A ships value quickly (bugfixes + Vue 3 + slim build) as v1.0; Phase B is the radical Tauri port as v2.0. Between phases, ~2 weeks user-stabilization window.

**Audit findings (mark-electron @ 85710af7, branch v1-on-tkaixiang, src/renderer/ scope = 119 files):**
20 of 119 files contain at least one violation. By category:
* **fs / fs/promises / fs-extra** — 4 import sites in 3 files: src/renderer/src/util/pdf.js:1, src/renderer/src/util/fileSystem.js:3 (statSync, constants), src/renderer/src/components/exportSettings/index.vue:263-264 (fs + fs/promises). Migration target: `window.fileUtils.*` already exposed via preload (writeFile/readFile/copy/move/stat etc.).
* **child_process** — 3 import sites: src/renderer/src/util/fileSystem.js:4 (exec, execFile for picgo/cliScript image uploaders), src/renderer/src/node/fileSearcher.js:1 (spawn), src/renderer/src/node/ripgrepSearcher.js:24 (spawn). Migration: relocate to src/main/search/ + src/main/imageUpload/ modules + new IPCs `mt::search-run`, `mt::search-cancel`, `mt::image-upload`.
* **crypto** — 1 site: src/renderer/src/util/fileSystem.js:1. Migration: new IPC `mt::hash-bytes` (sha256/md5).
* **os.tmpdir** — 1 site: src/renderer/src/util/fileSystem.js:5. Migration: replace with `await window.electron.process.tmpDir()` IPC.
* **Buffer global** — 6 usages in 2 files: src/renderer/src/util/fileSystem.js (3 sites: image.arrayBuffer→Buffer.from, base64 conversions for picgo/github upload), src/renderer/src/node/ripgrepSearcher.js (3 sites: byteLength + Buffer.from for base64 decode of vscode-ripgrep stdout). Migration: substitute browser TextEncoder/TextDecoder/btoa/atob; ripgrepSearcher moves to main anyway so these vanish.
* **process.* escape hatches** — 22+ usages in 14 files. Sub-categories: - `process.platform` (10+ sites): replace with `window.electron.process.platform` (already preload-exposed via @electron-toolkit/preload's electronAPI). - `process.env.NODE_ENV` (3 sites: bootstrap.js:7, prefComponents/sideBar/config.js:442, store/project.js:205): replace with Vite's `import.meta.env.MODE === 'development'` (compile-time injected, no runtime leak). - `process.env.UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY` (1 site: editor.vue:973): replace with `import.meta.env.VITE_UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY` (Vite env var prefix discipline). - `process.env.MARKTEXT_*` (multiple, e.g. paths.js:21,23, store/index.js:9): expose via preload as `window.electron.process.env.MARKTEXT_*` (electronAPI partial). - `process.env.HOME / PATH / APPIMAGE` (5+ sites in fileSystem.js, commands/utils.js): main-process-side only after the picgo/exec migration; renderer never sees them.
* **@electron/remote** — 6 import sites in 6 files: src/renderer/src/util/clipboard.js:3 (clipboard), src/renderer/src/contextMenu/{tabs,sideBar}/index.js:1 (Menu+MenuItem+getCurrentWindow), src/renderer/src/components/titleBar/index.vue:159 (getCurrentWindow+RemoteMenu), src/renderer/src/commands/index.js:2 (getCurrentWindow), src/renderer/src/prefComponents/common/titlebar.vue:14 (getCurrentWindow). Migration: clipboard → `window.electron.clipboard` (already exposed); getCurrentWindow().{minimize,maximize,close,isFullScreen} → new IPCs `mt::window-{minimize,maximize,close,toggle-fullscreen}`; RemoteMenu/RemoteMenuItem → new IPC `mt::context-menu-show` with serialized {label, accelerator, id, separator, enabled, checked} spec. After migration: drop `@electron/remote` dep entirely + remove the 3 `remoteEnable(window.webContents)` calls from main/index.js + main/windows/{editor,setting}.js.
* **@hfelix/electron-localshortcut** — 2 sites in keybinding prefs UI (prefComponents/keybindings/index.vue:63, key-input-dialog.vue:44): `setKeyboardLayout`. Migration: relocate to main; expose layout state via IPC `mt::keymap-set-layout` + read-only `window.electron.keymap`.
* **ipcRenderer.sendSync** — 1 site: store/editor.js:1327 (`mt::ask-for-image-path`). Migration: convert to `await ipcRenderer.invoke('mt::ask-for-image-path')`; caller must already be async (image-paste flow).
* **global.marktext writes** — 2 sites: src/renderer/src/main.js:26 (`global.marktext = {}`), src/renderer/src/bootstrap.js:106 (`global.marktext = marktext`). Migration: write to `window.marktext` instead; expose via preload contextBridge so the API survives nodeIntegration:false flip.
**Electron security context (separate from renderer code):** src/main/config.js declares `contextIsolation: false`, `nodeIntegration: true`, `webSecurity: false` for both window types (editor + setting). The cleanup is meaningless without the final flip to `contextIsolation: true`, `nodeIntegration: false`, `webSecurity: true` once renderer is clean. That flip is the closing ticket.
**Recommended split into 11+1 sub-tickets:** * step-8a: 4 fs imports → window.fileUtils.* (mechanical, no new IPC needed). * step-8b: process.platform → window.electron.process.platform (10+ files, 1-line edits each). * step-8c: process.env.NODE_ENV / UNSPLASH → import.meta.env.* (Vite-native). * step-8d: process.env.MARKTEXT_* / HOME / PATH → preload exposure tightening. * step-8e: @electron/remote.clipboard → window.electron.clipboard (1 site). * step-8f: @electron/remote.getCurrentWindow → new mt::window-* IPCs (5 sites + main handlers). * step-8g: @electron/remote.Menu / MenuItem → new mt::context-menu-show IPC (4 sites + main handler). * step-8h: child_process exec/execFile (picgo, cliScript) → main src/main/imageUpload/ + IPCs. * step-8i: child_process spawn (ripgrep, fileSearcher) → main src/main/search/ + IPCs (also retires Buffer sites in ripgrepSearcher). * step-8j: crypto + os.tmpdir → main IPCs `mt::hash-bytes`, `mt::tmp-dir`. * step-8k: ipcRenderer.sendSync → invoke (1 site, async caller chain). * step-8l: @hfelix/electron-localshortcut → main keymap module. * step-8m: global.marktext → window.marktext via preload contextBridge. * **step-8z:** flip src/main/config.js to contextIsolation:true / nodeIntegration:false / webSecurity:true; remove `@electron/remote` dependency from package.json; drop the 3 remoteEnable calls.
**Effort estimate (rough, single dev):** 5-8 working days end-to-end. Gating order: 8a→8b→8c→8d (renderer-only quick wins) → 8e→8f→8g (remote elimination) → 8h→8i→8j→8k→8l (IPC layer expansions) → 8m → 8z (security lockdown + dep removal). Patch.design: M-016 verifier MUST support DUAL public keys at v2.0.0 release (pub_key_current + pub_key_next slot, the latter empty initially). Without this, yearly rotation cannot reach existing v2.x users. Embedding: tauri.conf.json plugins.updater.pubkeys=[CURRENT, NEXT]; sourced from non-secret `src-tauri/embed_pub_keys.txt` (committed); private keys ONLY in 1Password + GHA env-protected secrets. Build-time: build.rs fails if TAURI_PUBKEYS env unset; embeds as compile-time constants. Rotation procedure (yearly rehearsal in Phase-B4 documented): (1) Generate new keypair via `tauri signer generate -p $NEW_PASSPHRASE` — designate as "next". (2) Ship a v2.x.y release where binary now embeds [CURRENT_old, NEXT_new] AND release feed is dual-signed by BOTH keys. (3) Overlap window ≥ 90 days; users on old binary verify via CURRENT_old, users who updated have NEXT_new but still verify CURRENT_old. (4) v2.x.y+1 release: binary embeds [NEXT_new, EMPTY_slot]; release feed signed by NEXT_new only. CURRENT_old retired. (5) Old signing key revoked from 1Password. Document in docs/release-rotation.md.

Patch.description: C2-8 dual-pubkey rotation strands users who skip the overlap-window release. Resolution: - **Adaptive overlap window**: hold open until ≥99% active installs report rolled to dual-key build via UA-version histogram from GitHub Releases stats; replace fixed 90d. - **Tertiary rescue pubkey**: embed a 5-year-cadence long-lived rescue ed25519 pub_key at v2.0.0 reserved exclusively for emergency re-bridging. Updater verifier accepts ANY of [pub_key_current, pub_key_next, pub_key_rescue]. Rescue private key kept in cold storage, NEVER used for routine releases. - **Recovery flow**: dual-key build writes `min-supported-feed-key` marker to mt_migration. If updater encounters feed it cannot verify with any embedded key, surfaces native dialog with signed-download link and human-readable reason — never silent fail. - New SC-V-M-016: 'binary-with-only-CURRENT_old offline 100d → online → updater rejects post-revoke feed gracefully → user sees recovery dialog with download link'.

Patch.description: v1 PR-4154 EPIPE fix is Electron-only. Tauri Rust panic-handler missing — any uncaught .unwrap() in tokio task = silent zombie window. Rotate, keep last 10. - Surface native dialog (i18n via C3-2): "Mark encountered an unexpected error. A crash report has been saved to <path>. Attach it to your GitHub issue." - Tokio task panics: use `tokio::task::JoinSet` + log `BLOCK_TASK_PANIC{task_name,trace_id}`; do NOT take down whole process unless invariant violated. - Telemetry-free stance: crash dumps local-only; user opt-in to attach. - New marker BLOCK_PANIC_HOOK_INSTALLED at boot. - SC: synthetic panic in fs/keyring/spell/updater paths each produces dialog + log file; window does not become zombie.
